_description: Manual entity-resolution ground truth, consumed by the ETCDR evaluation harness during the canonicalisation pre-step. Each cluster lists alias titles the extractor produced (UPPERCASE, as emitted) that should all collapse to the same canonical entity. The harness builds a merge_map (alias -> canonical) from this file and applies it to source/target in the extracted relationships before running ETCDR. Aliases that appear only once in the extracted output (no duplicates) should NOT be listed here.
